title: A ring receiving a surjection from a Noetherian ring is Noetherian
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings. If $R$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], then $S$ is Noetherian.
